Describe protocol/API, database migration, dependency, configuration and environment-variable changes, or write “None”. Include concurrency/UDP recovery evidence when relevant. Never include actual secrets.

## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `dev` (or an intentional `dev` → `main` release).
- [ ] Latest base changes integrated and relevant checks rerun.
- [ ] Only intended files are included; no secrets or generated output.
- [ ] Shared-file owners consulted and prerequisite PRs identified.
- [ ] Contracts, tests and documentation updated where needed.
- [ ] Conflict resolutions preserve both changes and have been reviewed.
